verdict.rationale: Segment's Public API reference at docs.segmentapis.com offers a direct 'Download OpenAPI specification' link for a versioned spec (73.3.0). The reference also documents auth, rate limits, pagination and versioning. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the downloaded spec, and evidence of machine-readable specs for the other APIs (e.g., Profile API and tracking APIs).
